**Issue #1656 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1656: Patch: a pack opening answers each token bar's before, after and what it paid
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

Part of #1651 (brief §3). The pack-opening scene will animate the card and cosmetic token bars from where they stood to where the opening left them, burst on each fill and reveal what it paid. The server owns the bars (CLAUDE.md rule 7), but `POST /api/packs/open` answers only `{ pack, slots, pity, unopened }` (`OpenedPack`, `crates/server/src/economy/packs.rs` ~l.61), `POST /api/cosmetic-packs/open` only its slots and Chase Shard bar (`OpenedCosmeticPack`, `economy/cosmetic_packs.rs` ~l.158), and `settle_bars` (`packs.rs` ~l.262), which both openings settle through, returns `()`.

### The wire (fixed: the bars, opening and store parts build against it)
Both opening answers gain `bars`:
`bars: { card: { before, after, size, pays }, cosmetic: { before, after, size, pays }, cosmeticPaid: ['rare' | 'epic' | 'cosmeticPack', …] }`
- `before`, `after`: the bar's points before the opening and after it (after keeps the overflow a pay leaves); `size`: `CARD_TOKEN_BAR_SIZE` or `COSMETIC_TOKEN_BAR_SIZE`; `pays`: how many times the bar paid in this opening (`economy/tokens.rs::settle_bar`'s count).
- `cosmeticPaid`: the `COSMETIC_TOKEN_CYCLE` steps the cosmetic bar paid, in order, serialised as `CosmeticTokenStep` is; its length is `cosmetic.pays`.
- A bar no spent duplicate moved answers before equal to after and `pays: 0`.
Client mirror in `apps/web/src/net/api.ts`: `export type BarSettle = { before: number; after: number; size: number; pays: number }`, `export type OpeningBarsAnswer = { card: BarSettle; cosmetic: BarSettle; cosmeticPaid: CosmeticTokenStep[] }`, and `bars: OpeningBarsAnswer` on `OpenedPackResponse` and `OpenedCosmeticPackResponse`.

No ruling: the answer reports what §14.5, R1305000 and R1305001 already settle; nothing pays differently.

### Files
`crates/server/src/economy/packs.rs` (`settle_bars` returns what it settled, `OpenedPack.bars`), `crates/server/src/economy/cosmetic_packs.rs` (`OpenedCosmeticPack.bars`), `crates/server/tests/api/packs.rs`, `crates/server/tests/api/cosmetic_packs.rs`, and `apps/web/src/net/api.ts` (the types above only).
Not here: `economy/roll.rs`, `cosmetics.rs`, `config.rs` and `get_packs` (the global roll part, which edits `packs.rs` and `api.ts` after this one); the web fixtures `packs/fixtures.ts` and `shop/fixtures.ts`, which the opening and store parts update.

### Done when
Server tests: a card pack whose spent duplicates carry the card token bar past `CARD_TOKEN_BAR_SIZE` answers the bar's points before and after and `pays` 1, with the token counted in `GET /api/tokens`; the cosmetic bar's `cosmeticPaid` is the cycle's next step; a pack with no spent duplicate answers both bars unmoved; a cosmetic pack's spent slot answers the same way. Run `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::packs`, `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::cosmetic_packs`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`. The web typecheck may stay red on the fixtures until the opening and store parts land: expected.

**Fullsend.** A part of #1651: it lands on `bot/issue-1651` with no checks or review of its own, beside the other parts. Change only the files named here. A check red only because a sibling part has not landed yet is expected. Leave `crates/server/README.md`, `apps/web/README.md` and the e2e specs to the reconcile.

Its build lands on `bot/issue-1651`, not `main` (fullsend).

Part of #1651, split by Night bot (`opus`, [run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/39819773251)).

6. Run the Done-when commands.
```
